question: Identify the antonym of "Ruthless":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Compassionate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Ruthless"** means showing no pity or compassion for others; being cruel and harsh. (निर्दयी)
 
 
• **Example:** The dictator was known for his ruthless policies that caused immense suffering.
 
 
• The word **"Compassionate"** refers to showing sympathy and concern for others, being kind and caring. (दयालु)
 
 
• **Example:** The nurse was compassionate, comforting the injured
